reference_sql:
WITH order_units AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT s.store_type, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, AVG(u.units) AS avg_units_per_order
FROM order_units u
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = u.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_type
alternatives: SELECT s.store_type, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n_orders, SUM(ol.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS avg_units_per_order FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id GROUP BY s.store_type

WITH order_units AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM order_lines GROUP BY 1) SELECT s.store_type, COUNT(u.order_id) AS n_orders, SUM(u.units) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_units_per_order FROM stores s JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN order_units u ON u.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1

solver.query:
WITH order_units AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, SUM(l.quantity) AS units
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.store_id
)
SELECT s.store_type, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, AVG(ou.units) AS avg_units_per_order
FROM order_units ou
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = ou.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_type
